description: Ham Radio Village explores amateur radio communications, emergency packet radio networks, satellite tracking, Software Defined Radio (SDR) signal processing, and mobile RF operations.

talks.title: The OSTRWERK Initiative
talks.teaser: Introduces the OSTRWERK open-source hardware initiative providing accessible RF tooling and equipment for amateur radio operators.

talks.title: What Makes a Good Operator
talks.teaser: Experienced amateur radio operators discuss essential operational discipline, on-air etiquette, and community mentoring.

talks.title: So You Have an SDR
talks.teaser: A hands-on guide for beginners on setting up and exploring radio spectrum using low-cost Software Defined Radio dongles.

talks.title: Talking to Satellites
talks.teaser: Explains how to track amateur satellites, calculate Doppler shift, and establish two-way voice and packet contacts.

talks.title: Single Board Computers in Amateur Radio
talks.teaser: Demonstrates deploying Raspberry Pi and single-board computers for digital amateur radio modes, APRS gateways, and remote control.

talks.title: The K0BAK News Van: Part 1
talks.teaser: Pete (K0BAK) details the conversion of a retired television news live broadcast van into a high-powered mobile amateur radio operations vehicle and field station.
talks.summary:
Repurposing Broadcast Vehicles for Mobile Radio

Retired television news broadcast vans offer robust chassis, integrated pneumatic masts, and isolated power systems ideal for heavy mobile amateur radio and emergency communications.

Pneumatic Mast and RF Antenna Mast Architecture

Pete (K0BAK) examines the mechanical restoration of the van's telescoping pneumatic antenna mast, detailing compressor controls, safety interlocks, and coaxial cabling harnesses.

Mobile Power Generation and Battery Banks

The speaker details rewiring the onboard commercial generator and DC battery banks to ensure clean, isolated, and sustained electrical power for high-wattage HF/VHF/UHF transceivers.

Operating a Mobile Field Communications Hub

The presentation demonstrates the completed internal operating console, field radio racks, and mobile deployment workflows for emergency communication drills.

talks.title: The K0BAK News Van: Part 2
talks.teaser: Walks through the mobile RF installation, power distribution, and antenna arrays in a converted news broadcast van.

talks.title: Ham Radio Snail Mail: NTS and the Radiogram Format
talks.teaser: Breaks down the National Traffic System (NTS) radiogram message format and relay protocols for emergency communications.

talks.title: APRS Demo
talks.teaser: Demonstrates the Automatic Packet Reporting System (APRS) protocol for transmitting GPS telemetry and tactical messages over VHF.
